games.name: [2 Player] Guess The Person
games.desc:
❗How to play Guess the Person 
Take turns asking questions. "Is it a man?" "Do they have brown hair?" You only press buttons. No typing.
Your opponent answers Yes or No. Then you look at THEIR board and flip down every face that cannot be it.
When one face is left on their board, guess it. The match does not end there. Your opponent gets time to make their guess too. Then both guesses are shown at the same time. You can BOTH be right.

👑 You get crowns when you win. Use crowns to buy win emotes - a dance your character does on the win screen, so the other player sees it.
🤖 Nobody to play with? Press Play Alone. A bot sits in the other seat and plays a real match.
⭐ How to play

1. Sit on a chair in the lobby
2. Pick your secret face
3. Ask, answer, flip
4. Guess their face before they guess yours

games.name: Ludo Arena! 🎲 [2-4 Players]
games.desc:
Ludo Arena is a fast, friendly board game for 2-4 players. Roll the dice,
move your pieces around the board, send your opponents back to start, and
be the first to bring all four pieces home.

No waiting around: jump straight into a match against smart bots, or
create a private room, share your code, and play with friends from any
server. Every match is quick, every roll matters.

🎲 HOW TO PLAY
Roll a six to leave your base. Move your pieces around the board.
Land on an opponent and send them back to the start. First player to
get all four pieces home wins.

👥 PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a private room, share the code, and your friends join you no matter
where they are. Invite friends directly from the menu in one tap.

🎨 COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Open chests to unlock new boards, dice and piece skins. Show them off at
the table — everyone sees what you're playing with.

⚡ BUILT TO BE QUICK
Matches are short enough for a break and good enough to run one more.
Runs smoothly on phone, tablet
